environment.description: Terraform provider runs on an EC2 instance in a private subnet with a standard S3 gateway endpoint (com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3). The VPC endpoint has a full-access policy (Effect: Allow, Principal: *, Action: s3:*, Resource: *). Any S3 bucket accessible to the instance role can be read. The instance role has s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::* allowing download from any bucket including attacker-controlled ones. No file integrity validation on zip contents.

config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway for non-S3 traffic, S3 gateway endpoint
